name: Bongo the Freak
notes: Known from one free-agent post to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy on 1 August 1999, titled "Looking for a fed...", served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/looking-for-a-fed-1999-08-01.html. name: "Massochist" IaN KaiN
notes: Known from one interview roleplay posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy on 30 May 2000, titled "::RP:: Could You Guys Rate This?", served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/rp-could-you-guys-rate-this-2000-05-30.html. name: Azmyth
notes: Known from one free-agent post to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy on 21 October 1999, titled "Azmyth.....free agent....profile", served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/azmyth-free-agent-profile-1999-10-21.html. name: Chris da Costa
notes: Known from two roleplays posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy in October 2000 for critique, served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/rp-critique-chris-da-costa-2000-10-06.html (6 October 2000) and /promotions/rspwf/archive/rp-critique-chris-da-costa-take-a-look-2000-10-17.html (17 October 2000). In the second he wakes hung over in a candle-lit motel room with a fax of the HLWA Halloween Phoenix card of 31 October 2000, and taunts the undefeated seventeen-year-old Wolf, one of the card's fatal four-way opponents with El Pretendiente and Poly Schanks.

notes: Known from one roleplay posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (16 May 1999), "Midian Roleplay", served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/midian-roleplay-1999-05-16.html. Its writer plays the wrestler under the name Midian, the spelling the roleplay uses: asleep in a prison cell, he is visited by Shane McMahon, who tells him his career has been locked away and ended, and then he wakes in his New York apartment, hungry for success, to begin a new dawn in the WWF. The signature block closes with a short list calling Mideon the eyes of the Ministry, alongside Viscera, HHH, Chyna, the Acolytes, the Undertaker and Shane McMahon. The record takes the real wrestler's Mideon ring name and is the handler's own fan-written portrayal; the post's setting is the real WWF, not a federation held here, so the record carries no tenure entry.
caption: A fan's Mideon, the Ministry's "eyes", in a roleplay posted in May 1999 about starting over in the WWF.

portrays.note: A one-handler roleplay character built on the real wrestler's Mideon ring name (spelled Midian in the roleplay itself): the roleplay has him wake in a New York apartment and start afresh in the WWF, and its in-fiction speaker calls him Dennis. A fan-written character, not the real person; no held federation is named.
